source: E0 tuning rounds R3 and R4 (experiments/E0_tuning/rounds.py), selection by the declared mechanical rule (experiments/E0_tuning/select_R3.py -> analysis/selection_R4_*.json); convergence quality only, never agreement with predictions (NORMS C14).

common.convergence: core/train.py DEFAULT_CONVERGENCE (grad_rel <= 1e-3; loss plateau <= 1e-4 and gamma change <= 1e-3 over the final 10% of steps; margin > 0)

product_nu3.R4_ok: 3/4 (p113 q2 not converged at 40k: gamma drift)

product_nu5.R4_ok: 1/6 at 40k over p = 13, 17, 23; p = 23: 0/8 converged, q = 2 runs had negative margin at 40k

steps_rule: Steps are a compute-budget choice made before evaluation (2 h full-sweep limit), never tuned on agreement: 150k for nu = 3, 4 (90k for nu = 4, p = 59, 2 batches of 6) and 300k for nu = 5 (p <= 17 only). R4 showed 40k steps is not enough at the larger p; more steps can only help the declared criterion.
scope_cuts: nu = 5 at p >= 23 is NOT run: R4 had 0/8 converged at p = 23 (40k steps) and 150k+ steps at p = 23 (10.7 ms/step for 8 runs) or p = 31 (46 ms/step) does not fit the 2 h sweep limit. Power nu = 4, 5 (optional in the plan) not run.
